speaker: char_AEGIOMON
source_samples: I wonder what'll happen to the world then... Aegiomon said to trust him, but...

speaker: char_KAMEMON
source_samples: The Coral Fragments haven't arrived yet. I asked Kamemon to get me some, but he still hasn't come back.

speaker: char_VENUSMON
source_samples: It's all thanks to Lady Venusmon. I may not be completely cured, but she never gave up and continued to treat me.

speaker: char_BACCHUSMON
source_samples: In the meantime, I shall keep an eye on Lord Bacchusmon and make sure he stays awake after all this drinking!

speaker: char_BACCHUSMON
source_samples: Just because Bacchusmon quit drinking, there's no excuse for him to eat like a glutton!

speaker: char_AEGIOMON
source_samples: What the Titans said about Aegiomon wouldn't be far from the truth. He would become a demon incarnate...

speaker: char_AEGIOMON
source_samples: Aegiomon learned of his destiny—to become the Great Guardian— and rose up to face the challenge of protecting the world. || To rescue his companion, Aegiomon awakened the power over time that lay dormant within him. || Aegiomon fell into a deep despair, from his failure to save his partner and from causing the destruction of the world.

speaker: char_CLAVISANGEMON
source_samples: ClavisAngemon is a dangerous opponent. Make sure to avoid him while we look for those two devices.

speaker: char_GRAPLEOMON
source_samples: GrapLeomon found his brother at long last. Now a slave of the Titans, Callismon had been forced to fight in the arena. || GrapLeomon set foot into the arena to save his older brother.

speaker: char_HANGYOMON
source_samples: This is Divermon. He doesn't want to fight anymore. Don't worry.

speaker: char_MERCURYMON
source_samples: Lord Merukimon is preparing to take the field, too. Do you think he can even fight in that state...? || The renewed Merukimon put his vaunted speed on full display.

speaker: char_RANAMON
source_samples: Come to think of it... where's Lanamon? I think she should know about this, too.

speaker: char_AEGIOMON
source_samples: I don't care what path Aegiomon takes! I have to repay him for everything he's done for me!

speaker: char_CORONAMON
source_samples: I got this for Coronamon when he said he wanted to travel, but I'm giving it to you. || Coronamon makes me so mad! I'm gonna sic Minnie on him as soon as he gets back!

speaker: char_JUNOMON
source_samples: Adored by Minervamon and many other Digimon, Junomon was filled with joy as she looked forward to fulfilling her sacred duty... || ...The duty of taking Iliad's Great Guardian under her wing, and helping to raise him into his proper form. Junomon eagerly awaited his arrival. || Junomon loved and cherished the Great Guardian so much that she could not hold back the feelings of jealousy that came from such love.

speaker: char_SUSANOOMON
source_samples: This is my master, Susanomon. You better not underestimate his strength. || The great hero of Shambala, Susanomon. You should feel honored to fight him.

speaker: char_MINERVAMON
source_samples: Adored by Minervamon and many other Digimon, Junomon was filled with joy as she looked forward to fulfilling her sacred duty...

speaker: char_SABMARIMON
source_samples: Submarimon is a bit odd, but he isn't a bad Digimon. Now you'll be able to go against the current.

speaker: char_PLUTOMON
source_samples: Forced to abdicate that throne, Plutomon made the underworld his new kingdom, where he would hand down judgement to errant souls... || I gave Plutomon what treatment I could. It was touch and go for a while... but he was able to pull through. || After saving Plutomon's life, he reveals Iliad's true past and the hidden truths within its history.

speaker: char_AEGIOMON
source_samples: Thus, Aegiomon and his human partner are now targets of eradication for ADAMAS.

speaker: char_AEGIOMON
source_samples: Aegiomon, who lost someone important to him and who was driven by pain, disrupted the laws of time. || Aegiomon wanted to reunite Inori Misono with her little brother. || The reason you're being mistaken for Aegiomon is because you were originally born from him.

speaker: char_BACCHUSMON
source_samples: Bacchusmon, overcome by grief and guilt, took a bottle of poison to his own lips...

speaker: char_MERCURYMON
source_samples: Lord Merukimon must have some kind of plan to stop them, right? I sure hope he does something soon... || Merukimon's the head honcho of this town! You should find him hanging out in the tavern down through that alley! || This is dreadful...! Where's Lord Merukimon?! Please, hurry to his side!

speaker: char_BACCHUSMON
source_samples: Please forgive Bacchusmon. He wasn't always like this...

speaker: char_CHARISMON
source_samples: Callismon's mind and heart were restored, but the modifications to his body could not be undone. || Marsmon took Callismon's plea to heart—it was the first time his older brother ever depended on him for anything.

speaker: char_NEPTUNEMON
source_samples: Neptunemon is defending our injured allies while trying to fight at the same time. That's why he's being pushed back.

speaker: char_SHELLMON
source_samples: Shellmon's house is on the outskirts of the village. Perhaps she would let her guard down and talk to outsiders like yourselves. || Maybe Shellmon would let her guard down and talk to outsiders like you.

speaker: char_PLUTOMON
source_samples: Despite his appearance, Plutomon is quite receptive. Just try talking to him.

speaker: char_WHAMON
source_samples: I noticed Whamon showing up as well. Did you summon him?

speaker: char_VULCANUSMON
source_samples: When Vulcanusmon finally got to visit, he connected with humans, exchanged knowledge and friendship with them, and truly enjoyed his time there. || However, that joy ended up being short-lived. Tragedy befell Vulcanusmon, as he found himself captured by humans with villainous intent. || Not only was Vulcanusmon used as a test subject, but in a true display of horror, his body was assimilated into the weapon.

speaker: char_AEGIOMON
source_samples: Aegiomon was the demon created by Chronomon, the surrogate meant to inherit his power to tamper with time.

speaker: char_BACCHUSMON
source_samples: It seems Bacchusmon is in a good mood. He probably wouldn't let you get away very easily. || Perhaps you may be able to do something about this situation. Bacchusmon is just ahead. Could you please talk to him?

speaker: char_BEELZEBUMON
source_samples: The issue isn't that simple. Defeating Beelzemon as he is now won't solve anything.

speaker: char_AEGIOMON
source_samples: Aegiomon says he woke up here, then made his way to us...

speaker: char_MERCURYMON
source_samples: If you're looking for Lord Merukimon, he's just further ahead. You should go see him. || Merukimon's body can hold out no longer. That fact has put urgency behind his decision. || But never mind that. You're looking to meet with Lord Merukimon, right? Well, you're in luck! He's inside.

speaker: char_AEGIOMON
source_samples: Aegiomon... said he wanted to be alone and headed up to the roof. || Aegiomon's not here. Did he go downstairs already? || I'll try talking to Aegiomon a little more when he wakes up.

speaker: char_MINERVAMON
source_samples: What? Minervamon? Ehh, she's probably with Merukimon. || Minervamon, the owner of this house, is not here... ...but I've seen her sister Lunamon around.

speaker: char_JESMON
source_samples: Impossible! Jesmon may be late a lot, but he's competitive and hates to lose, so no. || If ya find Jesmon, could ya let him know that I'm waiting?

speaker: char_JUNOMON
source_samples: Junomon has been acting strangely ever since being separated from the Great Guardian and having the treasure stolen from her...

speaker: char_JYUREIMON
source_samples: Cherrymon won't listen to me, so can you try talking to him instead?

speaker: char_TITAMON
source_samples: All signs indicate Titamon is stopping time. Normally, that would be impossible... but with the treasure in his grasp... || Titamon likely charges up his power while time is stopped. How can we counter that...?

speaker: char_RAVEMON
source_samples: Ravemon is incredible... He took out all those tough opponents in one go.

speaker: char_TONOSAMAGEKOMON
source_samples: ShogunGekomon hones his mind and spirit before a show. He will be in the sanctuary. || If ShogunGekomon isn't there, go find him! I need you to help me out with this, okay? || ShogunGekomon should be in the sanctuary honing his mind and spirit. Go bring him here!

speaker: char_APOLLOMON
source_samples: It was the right thing to do! We gotta actually get to Lord Apollomon first before we can talk to him! || Apollomon was so angry he scared me senseless... I wonder what happened... || Lord Apollomon just knocked everyone down like bowling pins! And then he melted right through the wall!

speaker: char_CORONAMON
source_samples: And that Coronamon is actin' all high and mighty too, just 'cause he got a little stronger...!

speaker: char_CORONAMON
source_samples: Could you please stop Coronamon and drag him out of the sewers? I'd do it myself but I'm useless in a fight...

speaker: char_MARSMON
source_samples: Marsmon took Callismon's plea to heart—it was the first time his older brother ever depended on him for anything. || Carrying on his brother's wishes, Marsmon swore to protect the world alongside his new friends.

speaker: char_STINGMON
source_samples: Haven't heard a peep since she went after Stingmon... But, knowing Lilamon, I'm sure she's doing fine!

speaker: char_PAILDRAMON
source_samples: Omigosh, Paildramon is awesome! He was SO cool back there!

speaker: char_PEGASMON
source_samples: I think you should talk to Pegasusmon over there. I heard he has recently seen the disturbance in Shinjuku for himself.

speaker: char_VENUSMON
source_samples: What about Venusmon, the Digimon working to remedy the poison? Any word on her progress?

speaker: char_SIRENMON
source_samples: Now that Sirenmon is interred in this land, perhaps she is cleansing the ground. || My vision was obstructed by the fog... but I never imagined it would be Sirenmon and her guests...

speaker: char_LILAMON
source_samples: Haven't heard a peep since she went after Stingmon... But, knowing Lilamon, I'm sure she's doing fine!

speaker: char_LILLYMON
source_samples: The Lillymon there before was all right, but she couldn't hold a candle to this LadyDevimon!

speaker: char_AEGIOMON
source_samples: The despair that Aegiomon carries within him will eventually transform him into rage incarnate. And then...

speaker: char_PLUTOMON
source_samples: It is said that if Lord Plutomon unleashes his special move, it instantly vaporizes any enemies in the area. || Lately, however, Lord Plutomon does not show himself, and makes only his orders known to the public. || That was when he encountered Lord Plutomon, and agreed to work for his newfound master.

speaker: char_TAOMON
source_samples: It's the legendary Taomon! And she's brought along Crowmon for the bout as well!
